name: Maji de Majikoi & Tsujidou Fans Discord ni Koi Shinasai
source:
This is a parody visual novel made solely by @Okiyuu on the MajiKoi/Tsujidou fan discord.

The premise is you're a protagonist who's joining the discord Class of MajiKoi/Tsujidou and figuring out what the culture is like there. This VN gets quotes and common scenarios from the discord to get an idea of what it's like in there as well as mixing in some fun VN elements.

There are some inside jokes and language that can be a bit... strong so just keep that in mind if you want to check this out.
translation:
這是一部由MajiKoi／Tsujidou粉絲Discord伺服器中的@Okiyuu獨立製作的惡搞視覺小說。

你將扮演一名加入MajiKoi／Tsujidou班級Discord的主角，探索這裡的社群文化。本作將群組裡的語錄與常見情境寫進遊戲，讓玩家瞭解其中的氛圍，同時融入有趣的視覺小說要素。

遊戲包含一些圈內梗，部分用語也可能有點……重口。如果你打算體驗，請留意這一點。
